feedback.problem: Find all of the subsets of $Q={\alpha ,\beta ,\gamma }.$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find every subset of $Q,$ we list out every combination of elements within $Q.$

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071627/assets/56d0ff0c0e539286b6c15496c7ad295008779f07f4e9132280c787b6303902c0.png)

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{\alpha },{\beta },{\gamma },{\alpha ,\beta },{\alpha ,\gamma },{\beta ,\gamma },{\alpha ,\beta ,\gamma }.
$$
